lines.en: Drifting in darkness
Flickering like ghostly light
I walk at the back of your neck.
Wandering in shadows
Cold breath by your ear
Faint song from afar
Flickering outline
Phantom-like figure
Swaying in the breeze
Low moan in shadows

lines.zh: 我贴着荒原的裂缝飘过去。
lines.en: I drift along the cracks of the waste.
The grass withers where I pass.
Lazily drifting

lines.zh: 我在荒原上找一块旧的界石。
lines.en: I search the waste for an old boundary stone.
I wander the shadowed wastes.

lines.zh: 半透明的袖子垂在残墙上。
lines.en: My half-seen sleeve hangs over the broken wall.
Silent as a ghost
Shadow in faint light
Endless wandering
Phantom in the night
Whisper in silence

lines.zh: 我数着荒原上还剩几根草。
lines.en: I count how few blades remain in the waste.

lines.zh: 祭坛边的烛火照不透我。
lines.en: The candle by the altar cannot shine through me.

lines.zh: 我停在旧祭坛的残柱旁。
lines.en: I pause by the broken pillars of an old altar.

lines.zh: 我在等一个会回头的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone who will look back.

lines.zh: 夜深了，我的轮廓更清楚。
lines.en: Deep night comes and my outline sharpens.
Even without a body, I still tire.
I breathe out one slow breath of cold.
Touched by your presence
I appear behind you.
You smell like prey

lines.zh: 我顺着你的视线贴过去。
lines.en: I slide along the line of your gaze.
Your scent drew attention

lines.zh: 我就在你背后，抓你上天。
lines.en: I'm right behind you — up you go.
Approach is dangerous
You can't escape my sight
Following your steps
You're my prey
Where you have walked, I follow.

lines.zh: 你的火把在我眼里发青。
lines.en: Your torch burns green in my sight.

lines.zh: 你回头看了两次，第三次呢？
lines.en: You looked back twice — what about the third?

lines.zh: 我在你左边，也在你右边。
lines.en: I am on your left, and on your right.

lines.zh: 幽魂的厉啸穿透你的耳膜。
lines.en: The Eidolon's wail pierces your ears.

lines.zh: 你感到一股寒意从背后袭来。
lines.en: A chill runs down your spine.

lines.zh: 幽魂的利爪划过你的肌肤。
lines.en: Eidolon's claws scrape your skin.

lines.zh: 一阵阴冷的风从幽魂中吹出。
lines.en: A cold wind blows from the Eidolon.

lines.zh: 你看见幽魂的身影掠过。
lines.en: You see the Eidolon's silhouette.

lines.zh: 幽魂的魔力侵袭着你的身体。
lines.en: Eidolon's magic seeps into your body.

lines.zh: 你被幽魂的怨念所侵扰。
lines.en: You are tormented by the Eidolon's怨念。

lines.zh: 幽魂的尖叫回荡在你耳边。
lines.en: The Eidolon's scream echoes in your ears.

lines.zh: 幽魂用它的邪灵之力伤了你。
lines.en: Eidolon's wicked magic hurts you.

lines.zh: 幽魂的阴影在你周围凝聚。
lines.en: Eidolon's shadow gathers around you.

lines.zh: 青色薄翼轻拂过你的肩膀
lines.en: Pale wings brush your shoulder.
Eidolon whispers, drawing you near.

lines.zh: 它的眼中闪烁着饥饿的光芒
lines.en: Its eyes glow with hunger.

lines.zh: 跟随我，让你的灵魂飘荡
lines.en: Follow me, let your soul drift.

lines.zh: 腐朽的魔力让你难以抗拒
lines.en: Decaying magic draws you in.

lines.zh: 它的声音如同夜风般诱人
lines.en: Its voice is a seductive night breeze.
Its beauty ensnares you.

lines.zh: 幽魂的微笑中藏着死亡
lines.en: Its smile holds death.
It invites you to wander.

lines.zh: 它的存在让人无法忽视
lines.en: Its presence cannot be ignored

lines.zh: 你的身体撞上了它的幻影
lines.en: Your body hits its ethereal form.
It appears suddenly behind you.

lines.zh: 你撞上了一团无形的力量
lines.en: You collide with an invisible force.

lines.zh: 它的存在感让你猝不及防
lines.en: Its presence catches you off guard.

lines.zh: 你撞上了一个无形的牢笼
lines.en: You collide with an invisible cage.
It appears out of nowhere, colliding with you.

lines.zh: 你撞上了一个飘浮的影子
lines.en: You collide with a floating shadow.

lines.zh: 它的存在让你无法躲避
lines.en: Its presence makes you unable to avoid.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的虚无之躯
lines.en: You collide with its ethereal form.

lines.zh: 它的出现让你措手不及
lines.en: Its appearance catches you off guard
Seek a mate, an Eidolon's companion.

lines.zh: 它的伴侣在暗影中等待
lines.en: Its mate waits in the shadows.

lines.zh: 幽魂的伴侣同样虚无缥缈
lines.en: Its mate is equally ethereal.

lines.zh: 与它并肩，成为永恒的伴侣
lines.en: Be its partner, an eternal companion.
Find a partner to dance with.

lines.zh: 幽魂的伴侣在暗影中闪烁
lines.en: Its mate glimmers in the shadows.

lines.zh: 它的伴侣是你灵魂的归宿
lines.en: Its mate is your soul's home.

lines.zh: 幽魂的伴侣也是它的猎物
lines.en: Its mate is also its prey.
Find a partner to coexist with.

lines.zh: 幽魂伴侣的光辉引你靠近
lines.en: Its mate's light draws you near
The shadowy wind whispers in your ear.

lines.zh: 你背后的冷气，是我先到的。
lines.en: The chill behind you is me arriving first.

lines.zh: 你被一股无形的力量拉起。
lines.en: You are pulled up by an unseen force.

lines.zh: 它在你背后伸出了爪子。
lines.en: Its claws reach out from behind you.
It hurls you high into the air.
The icy touch threatens to suffocate you.
You are sucked into a dark vortex.
A cold light slices through the darkness.

lines.zh: 你失去了平衡，跌落下去。
lines.en: You lose your balance and fall.
You hear its whispers.

lines.zh: 你的气息落入它的感知。
lines.en: Your presence enters its senses.

lines.zh: 你影子的边缘，我先咬住了。
lines.en: I bite the edge of your shadow first.
It moves closer to you.

lines.zh: 它的心中燃起愤怒之火。
lines.en: Anger burns in its heart.

lines.zh: 它准备好了，要发起攻击。
lines.en: It is ready to strike.
Your shadow trembles.
Hate glows in its eyes.
It has set its sights on you.

lines.zh: 它的动作变得迅速而致命。
lines.en: Its movements become quick and deadly.
It waits for the perfect moment.

lines.zh: 荒原上多了一个活人的热气。
lines.en: A living warmth has entered the waste.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进了我的地盘。
lines.en: Your shadow has fallen into my ground.
It watches your form.
Its magic targets you.
You are under its gaze.
Its gaze pierces the darkness.
Its psionic lock is on you.

lines.zh: 它的精神之眼在寻找你。
lines.en: Its psychic eye seeks you.
It has taken you into its sight.

lines.zh: 它的注视让你感到不安。
lines.en: Its stare unnerves you.
Its psychic power focuses on you.
It is about to deliver the final blow.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，没人看得见。
lines.en: I slip behind you, unseen.

lines.zh: 我的手已经搭上你的肩膀。
lines.en: My hand is already on your shoulder.
Once your feet leave the ground, you are mine.
I am above you, waiting to let go.
Grabbing at anything will not help you.

lines.zh: 我的爪子从背后扣住你。
lines.en: My claws clamp on you from behind.
Leap at you, feel pain!
Pick you up, throw to void!
Dark power, tear you apart!

lines.zh: 我把你抛向荒原的空中。
lines.en: I hurl you up into the waste's empty air.
Devour souls, enjoy it!
You'll feel fear!
Fall, fall, fall!

lines.zh: 痛苦将是你唯一的语言！
lines.en: Pain will be your only language!
Consumed by darkness, wail!

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领，向上提！
lines.en: I seize your collar and haul you up!
I let go — now fall!
Appear from shadows, seek prey!
Awake in dark corners!
Eidolon of shadows appears!
I spy from the dark!
I wander in the wasteland!
Risen from shadows, I am!
I gaze from the dark!
I roam the shadow wastes!
I hunt on the wasteland!

lines.zh: 黑暗里，我苏醒，准备狩猎！
lines.en: Awake in darkness, ready to hunt!

lines.zh: 荒原上浮起一层灰白的雾。
lines.en: A pale grey mist rises over the waste.

lines.zh: 祭坛的残柱间，我显形了。
lines.en: Between the broken pillars, I take shape.

lines.zh: 死草的味道先到，我后到。
lines.en: The smell of dead grass arrives first; then I do.
I always appear behind you.
You are consumed by flames.
You fall from the sky.

lines.zh: 幽魂的怨念让你溺水窒息。
lines.en: The Eidolon's resentment drowns you.

lines.zh: 爆炸的冲击波撕裂你的身体。
lines.en: The explosion's shockwave tears through your body.
The Eidolon's curse hits you.

lines.zh: 魔法的力量穿透你的防御。
lines.en: Magic pierces your defenses.

lines.zh: 饥饿的折磨让你虚弱无力。
lines.en: Starvation weakens you.
Lightning strikes you.
Infinite darkness consumes you.
